limitations: The cache records total and timestamp, not valuation warnings or component breakdowns; reported account marks are not independently reconciled historical NAV. Known failed observations were excluded or replaced at their own timestamps.
Trading-only Apr25–29 points explicitly sum positions and cash while the crypto sleeve was unfunded; all-in total and gas remain unknown.
Rounded-identity gas is an estimate from contemporaneous published inputs and the historical accounting function; only rounding uncertainty is quantified.
No gas values, daily prices or whole-account valuations were interpolated or borrowed from other observations. VM/API costs and historic gas acquisition values remain unreconciled.
PM depth is indicative after fees, sequential and not guaranteed proceeds; old gross/incorrect-fee walks remain excluded.
